industries.name: Financial Services
industries.description: A bounded branch-connectivity reference showing how verified network evidence can inform a modeled payment-service dependency risk.
industries.implemented_scope: One synthetic branch/WAN degradation reference; not comprehensive financial-services support.

business_capabilities.name: Branch payment servicing
business_capabilities.description: Modeled capability representing branch access to a payment application.
business_capabilities.objective: Maintain technical reachability between the branch and supporting payment service.

environments.name: Retail branch connectivity
environments.description: Synthetic branch, WAN, payment application, and business capability dependencies.
investigation_objectives: Find the interface incident and order its technical timeline.
Trace the modeled dependency path to the payment-service capability.
Validate technical recovery before clearing modeled business risk.

entities.label: Synthetic Branch Edge
entities.description: Fictional edge device represented by existing verified network telemetry.

entities.label: Branch WAN Service
entities.description: Modeled network-service dependency; no carrier SLA is asserted.

entities.label: Payment Application Reachability
entities.description: Modeled application dependency; no transaction events are generated.

entities.label: Branch Payment Servicing
entities.description: Modeled capability risk only; transaction volume and financial loss are not established.

dependencies.assumption: The synthetic branch uses the modeled edge path for WAN reachability.
No independently instrumented alternate application path is modeled.
The capability depends on application reachability, not on any modeled transaction count.

operational_objectives.name: Branch service reachability
operational_objectives.statement: Restore observed network state before clearing modeled branch-service risk.

business_impacts.title: Payment-service availability risk
business_impacts.statement: Branch payment servicing may be disrupted while its only modeled network dependency is degraded.
assumptions: The modeled WAN path is required.
No alternate path is instrumented in this reference.
exclusions: No payment transaction, cardholder data, transaction count, revenue loss, or customer outcome is generated or asserted.

business_capabilities.name: Clinical application access

business_capabilities.objective: Maintain network reachability to the synthetic clinical application.

environments.name: Hospital campus connectivity
environments.description: Synthetic campus edge, segmented network, clinical application, and workflow dependencies.
investigation_objectives: Validate network recovery without asserting a clinical outcome.

entities.label: Synthetic Hospital Edge
entities.description: Fictional campus device represented by verified interface telemetry.

entities.label: Clinical Application Segment
entities.description: Modeled segmented network dependency; no medical-device protocol is generated.

entities.label: Synthetic Clinical Application
entities.description: Synthetic application dependency with no patient or clinical record data.

entities.label: Clinical Application Access
entities.description: Hypothetical operational risk only; patient-care impact is not established.

dependencies.assumption: The synthetic segment uses the modeled campus edge.
No alternate clinical application path is instrumented.
Network reachability is one technical dependency, not proof of clinical availability.

operational_objectives.name: Clinical application reachability

operational_objectives.name: Production monitoring visibility
